firmware.note: v0.1.5 (built 2026-11-18): robustness build. Date belief + last rendered date persisted in NVS (survive power cuts); dateless fallback paint advances at most one day per outage (review fix); RTC hardware watchdog armed during wakes; WiFi joins pick the strongest access point for the SSID; setup page gains a force-update checkbox, signal-strength network list, last-connection report, status line, test-paint button and forget-network button. Schedule v2 remains the embedded baseline. The firmware channel reads only version + url; sha256/sizeBytes recorded for verification. httpUpdate fetches the APP image, not the merged flash image.
